description: Targeted safety shortlist for who_must_not_hold on the required-hold four-phase candidate. Selected = targeted safety ingest permission. Not a product who-list. Not canon. Canon: docs/practices/PRACTICE_TECHNIQUE_TARGETED_SAFETY_SHORTLIST_V1.md
research_question: For a technique whose identity includes required breath holds, which conditions or circumstances require not performing breath holds, or require prior professional assessment?

expression_hypothesis.note: Safety shortlist does not attest the probe.

structural_finding: Official-health pages for this method do not publish a who-list. Breathlessness-rehab official health discourages holding during exertion, a different job. Peer-reviewed yoga literature contraindicates kumbhaka in hypertension and heart disease. Those are different speech acts. This pass does not glue them into a binary product who_must_not_hold list and does not rewrite Safety Review V1. If later review needs exclude / precaution / stop_rule instead of binary must_not, that is an owner decision for Safety Review V1.1 after ingest.
